AFG.text: Afghanistan's statistics office (NSIA) estimates 36.4 million people for the year 2025-26. The UN's figure for mid-2025 is 43.8 million, 20% higher. Neither is a count: the last census was in 1979, and NSIA's figure is a projection forward from a 2003-05 household listing.

unFigure.what: UN population on 1 July 2025 (forecast)

links.label: National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA), Estimated Population of Afghanistan 2025-26, September 2025

quotes.text: The total population of the country in 1404 (2025-26) is estimated to be about 36.4 million persons, of which around 18.6 million persons (51.0%) are males and 17.8 million persons (49.0%) are females
The Population Estimates publication of 1404 (2025-26) has been prepared based on the data obtained from household listing of 1381-1384 (2003-05), using the (Pt = P0 ert) formula.
Due to the existence of security and economic problems, the second complete population census of the country after the population census of 1358 has not yet been conducted
